algorithm: ScaleDP (Scale Diffusion Policy, transformer-based diffusion action head, up to 1B parameters, multi-head per embodiment) plugged into a Qwen2-VL-2B VLA backbone, trained with a 3-stage 'Embodied Curriculum Learning' recipe; loss L = Ldiff + αLntp (α=1)
hand: Robotiq parallel-jaw gripper (Franka rig a, Bimanual UR5e rig c); Inspire multi-fingered dexterous hand, 6-DoF hand joint space (Franka rig b); AgileX bimanual arm end-effector unnamed (rig d)
arm: Franka Emika 7-DoF (single-arm, two variants: with gripper and with dexterous hand); Bimanual UR5e (2x); Bimanual AgileX 6-DoF (2x, one mobile variant)
sim: LIBERO (secondary, App. A.2 only; main results are real-robot)
success_criterion: task-specific point rubrics scored per trial (e.g. laundry folding scored out of 4, drink pouring out of 2), reported as a normalized score averaged over 10 episodes per task and method
headline_metric: normalized task score, no task-specific adaptation (Fig. 6, 10 trials/task)
headline_value: shirt folding (Bimanual AgileX) 0.92 vs. Diffusion Policy/Octo/OpenVLA struggling to complete any steps; bin picking easy (Franka+gripper) 0.77; new-embodiment average 0.90 across packing and drink pouring (Fig. 8); LIBERO average 97.3 vs. π0 97.1, π0-FAST 93.9, OpenVLA 84.1 (Table 5)
paper_code_mismatch: code/md only carries class/function signatures, not bodies, for the diffusion head (modeling_scaledp.py) and no config file with the α weight was captured; the paper's diffusion loss and denoising process cannot be verified against code bodies — only the multi-head ScaleDP signature and a DDIM fp32 patch are available, so none of the paper's tables can be reproduced from what was parsed.
note_gaps: Fig. 6 and Fig. 8 bar-to-method/value mapping is ambiguous in the extracted markdown (flattened figure text, exact assignment uncertain); exact action-chunk length / prediction_horizon numeric value is not stated in either paper or code.
backbone: Qwen2-VL-2B (used off-the-shelf, "without any post training on VLM itself")
params: diffusion expert up to 1B parameters (ScaleDP-H, also a ~400M ScaleDP-L variant); backbone Qwen2-VL-2B
action_head: ScaleDP (Scale Diffusion Policy), a Diffusion-Policy-in-Transformer variant with a multi-head output (one head per robot embodiment/configuration), 32 layers, hidden size 1280, 16 heads, ResNet-50 per-camera-view image features, FiLM-injected reasoning tokens from the VLM for implicit sub-step planning
pretrain_data: ~100 hours of real-robot teleoperated demonstration data across 91 tasks and 4 embodiments, used across a 3-stage Embodied Curriculum Learning recipe
dexterous_evidence: "dexterous-hand-evaluated: yes — but only for one real-robot task family (drink pouring/packing new-embodiment tests, §4.2, plus its Table-4 generalization variant and the App. A.5 zero-shot probe), while the shirt-folding/bussing/sorting/bin-picking/laundry/dryer-unloading headline tasks all run on parallel-jaw grippers."
